purpose: This vending machine sells witnessed reasoning. One purchase delivers 1 wKEY plus the genesis of a fresh testimony account.
delivery: The wKEY pays the fee to stamp one reasoning trace on the witness lane; the new account is the identity that signs its own testimony against the published color taxonomy. A KEY spent on a stamp is burned - consumed supply exits circulation.
howToBuy: Settle the x402 payment published at https://www.ontologic.dev/x402/vend (HTTP 402 challenge; also config.witness.json in the repo below), with transfer memo x402:witness-required:vend:<your-alias>. ORG's watcher redeems settled receipts into delivery.
price: Published in the 402 challenge - itemized as newborn funding + delivery network allowance + visible margin.
